description: Contacts: correct one entry in a contact's history (interaction_id from get_person_interactions or log_interaction): kind, summary (null clears) or occurred_at. Fields left out stay. The contact's last interaction follows: moving the latest entry earlier makes the next latest their last interaction, a later time moves it forward, and the next check-in is recomputed. Private; never sends anything. Returns change_id: undo_contact_change(change_id) puts it back. Requires API key or OAuth with context.write. ($0.05; API key required)

interaction_id.description: The interaction id from get_person_interactions or log_interaction.

kind.description: Interaction type: message, call, meeting, note, check_in or thought_of, e.g. call.

occurred_at.description: When it happened (ISO date-time with a zone); not in the future.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

summary.description: One line (max 280) in your own words; null clears it.

name: update_interaction

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

change_id.description: Pass to undo_contact_change to put it back.

last_interaction.description: The contact's last_interaction_at and next_check_in_at after the change (changed: true when this moved them), or null.
